theorems.statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (J : Euclid m → ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid m)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet A → ContinuousOn G A → InjOn G A → Measurable J → (∀ w ∈ A, 0 ≤ J w) → (∀ B : Set (Euclid m), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ A → μ (G '' B) = ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J w)) → ∫ y in G '' A, f y ∂μ = ∫ w in A, J w * f (G w)
